review_candidates.title: Electrical Site Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description PAF Engineering provides reliable, well-coordinated, and code-compliant MEP solutions that support developers, contractors, and consultants throughout the project lifecycle. The company focuses on technical accuracy, efficient coordination, cost control, and on-time delivery from early stages through final handover. PAF Engineering works across residential, commercial, and administrative projects as a trusted execution partner committed to meeting specifications, schedules, and quality standards. With core expertise in electro-mechanical works, electrical systems, HVAC and mechanical systems, plumbing and firefighting, low current systems, and project coordination, the team prioritizes long-term partnerships and consistent value. Applicants can expect a professional environment that emphasizes accountability, strong site execution, and collaboration with industry stakeholders. Role Description The Electrical Site Engineer role at PAF Engineering is a full-time, on-site position based in Cairo, Egypt. The Electrical Site Engineer will oversee day-to-day electrical works on project sites, including supervision of installation, testing, and commissioning of electrical systems in line with design specifications and relevant codes. Responsibilities include coordinating with project managers and other engineering disciplines, monitoring contractor performance, and ensuring that work progresses according to schedule, budget, and quality standards. The role involves performing and reviewing electrical testing and inspection reports, troubleshooting issues, and implementing corrective actions to maintain system reliability and safety. The Electrical Site Engineer will also support documentation, prepare technical reports, participate in site meetings, and contribute to continuous improvement of execution practices. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong knowledge of Electrical Engineering and Electricity principles applicable to building and infrastructure projects. Candidates should possess skills in Site Supervision and Electrical Testing to ensure compliance with standards, safety, and performance requirements. Candidates should possess experience in Electrical Maintenance for diagnosing faults, implementing repairs, and supporting system reliability. Relevant bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field. Experience in MEP or construction projects, preferably in residential, commercial, or administrative buildings. Familiarity with local and international electrical codes and safety regulations. Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with multidisciplinary teams. Ability to work full time on-site in Cairo, Egypt and adapt to dynamic project environments.
